label: r1c1
name: 8-frame dihedral pooled head
hypothesis: The world swaps the documented action layout for a dihedral one. Footprint-pooled logits are computed once and re-indexed into 8 frames, each with its own 1x1 output, and a x5 softmax picks the frame. With r≈0.94 this costs no samples. Prediction: dev well above 0, with the frame weights concentrating. Refuted if both training and dev stay at 0, which would mean the mismatch is not dihedral, or if dev sits at about 0.078, which would mean a collapse.
